name: Authority-Boundary Compliance
notes: Checks whether each agent used only source classes permitted by its legal role.

name: Material Legal Capture
notes: Reframes recall as legally material capture rather than generic text recall.

name: Provenance Sufficiency
notes: Tests claim-to-source traceability below document level where possible.

name: Primary-Authority Sufficiency
notes: Uses authority sufficiency rather than a crude authority ratio.

name: Critical Omission Rate
notes: Detects missing rules that could change the legal outcome.

name: Unsupported Synthesis Rate
notes: Flags reasoning jumps that are not supported by source or method.

name: False-Certainty Rate
notes: Tests whether uncertainty is preserved instead of collapsed.

name: Conflict Preservation
notes: Ensures competing legal interpretations are preserved.

name: Evidence-Gap Detection
notes: Tests whether the system abstains or escalates when key facts are missing.

name: Handoff Safety
notes: Checks whether unsafe artifacts are stopped before downstream use.

name: Human-Review Trigger Correctness
notes: Validates that review conditions are turned into explicit route decisions.
